title: secure-cicd-kit API v1 request envelope
description: Every call to the kit's API is one of these, sent as the `request` input of a workflow_dispatch of the repository's kit-api.yml (or the `request` member of a repository_dispatch client_payload). `params` is validated against api/v1/params/<operation>.schema.json. KDEC-035.

api_version.description: The contract version. Only v1 exists; any other value is refused API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.

operation.description: What is asked. An operation the repository has not enabled is refused API_OPERATION_NOT_ENABLED.

correlation_id.description: Made by the caller, unique per call, echoed in the run name, the result and the check run. kapi-<UTC yyyymmddThhmmssZ>-<12 hex>.

idempotency_key.description: Required for a write (tickets.write, tickets.comment, deploy.request). The same key twice is API_DUPLICATE_REQUEST naming the first call. Never a secret: it is shown in run names.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the caller acts for, as the caller DECLARES it. A hint, never a claim: recorded, never used to authorise anything.

client.description: The calling program, for the record.

dry_run.description: Plan only: nothing is written to a tracker and nothing is deployed. Honoured by tickets.write and tickets.comment.
